title: Climate Policy and the Long-Run Interest Rate: Insights From a Simple Growth Model
abstract: We study the impact of climate policy on the long-run real interest rate in a neoclassical growth model. A carbon price reduces the long-run rate only if it grows faster than at least one fossil fuel price. Consider a carbon price that grows at 5 percent per year. This tax reduces the long-run rate by 25 basis points if fossil fuel prices grow at their historical rates and by 77 basis points if they are constant. A carbon price that implements the least-cost path to net zero reduces the long-run rate by up to 54 basis points.
abstract_zh: 我们在一个新古典增长模型中研究了气候政策对长期实际利率的影响。只有当碳价格的增长速度至少快于某一种化石燃料价格时，碳价格才会降低长期利率。假设碳价格每年增长5%。如果化石燃料价格按历史增速增长，该税收将使长期利率降低25个基点；如果化石燃料价格保持不变，则降低77个基点。实现净零排放最低成本路径的碳价格，最多可使长期利率降低54个基点。

title: A Macro Study of the Unequal Effects of Climate Change
abstract: This paper develops a macro heterogeneous-agent model to quantify the distributional impacts of higher temperatures resulting from climate change in the United States. Households adapt to temperature through two channels: an intensive margin—adjusting energy use for heating and cooling—and an extensive margin—deciding whether to purchase temperature-control equipment such as a heater, air conditioner or heat pump. I estimate the production functions for household heating and cooling from a unique product-level data set and calibrate the remaining parameters to match variation in energy expenditures and budget shares with income levels. I find that the welfare effects of climate change vary substantially with income and region. In colder areas, climate change increases inequality in lifetime welfare. While all households experience greater cooling needs, the costs are particularly acute for lower-income households, who purchase air conditioners that they did not previously need. In warmer areas, the opposite pattern reduces welfare inequality.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个宏观异质性主体模型，用以量化美国气候变化导致的气温升高对收入分配的影响。家庭通过两种渠道适应气温变化：集约边际——调整供暖和制冷的能源使用；以及扩展边际——决定是否购买取暖器、空调或热泵等温控设备。我利用一套独特的产品层面数据集估计了家庭供暖和制冷的生产函数，并校准了其余参数，以匹配能源支出和预算份额随收入水平的变化。我发现，气候变化的福利效应随收入和地区的不同而有很大差异。在较寒冷的地区，气候变化加剧了终生福利的不平等。尽管所有家庭的制冷需求都会增加，但对低收入家庭而言，成本尤为沉重，因为他们购买了以前并不需要的空调。在较温暖的地区，则呈现相反的格局，从而降低了福利不平等。

title: Homework in Climate Economics: Household Production, Environmental Preferences, and Climate Policy
Understanding Climate Damages: Consumption vs. Investment
abstract: Existing climate-economy models use aggregate damage functions to model the effects of climate change. This approach assumes climate change has equal impacts on the productivity of firms that produce consumption and investment goods or services. We show the split between damage to consumption and investment productivity matters for the dynamic consequences of climate change. Drawing on the structural transformation literature, we develop a framework that incorporates heterogeneous climate damages. When investment is more vulnerable to climate, we find short-run consumption losses will be smaller than leading models with aggregate damage functions suggest, but long-run consumption losses will be larger. We quantify these effects for the climate damage from heat stress and find that accounting for heterogeneous damages increases the welfare cost of climate change by approximately 4 to 24 percent, depending on the discount factor.
abstract_zh: 现有的气候—经济模型使用总量损害函数来刻画气候变化的影响。这种方法假定气候变化对生产消费品和投资品或服务的企业的生产率具有同等影响。我们表明，消费生产率损害与投资生产率损害之间的差异，对气候变化的动态后果至关重要。借鉴结构转型文献，我们构建了一个纳入异质性气候损害的框架。当投资更易受气候影响时，我们发现，短期消费损失将小于采用总量损害函数的主流模型所显示的程度，但长期消费损失则会更大。我们针对热应激造成的气候损害对这些效应进行了量化，发现考虑异质性损害后，气候变化的福利成本将增加约4%至24%，具体取决于贴现因子。

title: Understanding the Welfare and Inequality Impacts of Carbon Tax Policies
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: This paper develops a general equilibrium lifecycle model to explore the welfare and inequality implications of different ways to return carbon tax revenue back to households. We find that the welfare maximizing rebate uses two thirds of carbon-tax revenue to reduce the distortionary tax on capital income while using the remaining one third to increase the progressivity of the labor-income tax. This recycling approach attains higher welfare and more equality than the lump-sum rebate approach preferred by policymakers as well as the approach originally prescribed by economists __ which called exclusively for reductions in distortionary taxes.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个一般均衡生命周期模型，以探讨将碳税收入返还给家庭的不同方式所带来的福利和不平等影响。我们发现，使福利最大化的返还方式是，将三分之二的碳税收入用于减少对资本收入的扭曲性税收，同时将其余三分之一用于提高劳动收入税的累进性。与政策制定者偏好的一次性总额返还方式，以及经济学家最初所主张的仅用于减少扭曲性税收的方式相比，这种循环利用方式能够实现更高的福利和更平等的结果。

title: Electrification and Firm Productivity: A General Equilibrium Approach
Climate Policy Transition Risk and the Macroeconomy
abstract: Uncertainty surrounding if the U.S. will implement a federal climate policy introduces risk into the decision to invest in long-lived capital assets, particularly those designed to use, or to replace fossil fuel.  We develop a dynamic, general equilibrium model to quantify the macroeconomic impacts of this climate policy transition risk. The model incorporates beliefs over the likelihood that the government adopts a climate policy causing the economy to dynamically transition to a lower carbon economy. We find that climate policy transition risk decreases carbon emissions today by causing investment to fall and become relatively cleaner. This emissions reduction however, represents only a small fraction of the reduction that would be achieved by adopting the carbon price, and it comes at a much higher cost.
abstract_zh: 美国是否会实施联邦气候政策存在不确定性，这给长期资本资产的投资决策带来了风险，尤其是那些用于使用或替代化石燃料的资产。我们建立了一个动态一般均衡模型，用以量化这种气候政策转型风险的宏观经济影响。该模型纳入了关于政府采取气候政策可能性的信念，这一政策将促使经济动态地转向低碳经济。我们发现，气候政策转型风险通过抑制投资并使投资转向相对更清洁的方向，从而降低了当前的碳排放。然而，这种减排只占采用碳价格所能实现减排量的一小部分，且代价要高得多。

title: Projecting the Impact of Rising Temperatures: The Role of Macroeconomic Dynamics
abstract: We use theory and empirics to distinguish between the impact of temperature on transition (temporary) and steady state (permanent) growth in output per capita. Standard economic theory suggests that the long-run growth rate of output per capita is determined entirely by the growth rate of total factor productivity (TFP). We find evidence suggesting that the level of temperature affects the level of TFP, but not the growth rate of TFP. This implies that a change in temperature will have a temporary, but not a permanent, impact on output per capita growth. To highlight the quantitative importance of distinguishing between permanent and temporary changes in economic growth, we use our empirical estimates and theoretical framework to project the impacts of future increases in temperature caused by climate change. We find losses that are substantial, but smaller than those in the existing empirical literature that assumes a change in temperature permanently affects economic growth.
abstract_zh: 我们运用理论和实证方法，区分了气温对人均产出的过渡性（暂时性）增长与稳态（永久性）增长的影响。标准经济理论认为，人均产出的长期增长率完全由全要素生产率（TFP）的增长率决定。我们发现有证据表明，气温水平影响TFP的水平，但不影响TFP的增长率。这意味着，气温变化将对人均产出增长产生暂时性而非永久性的影响。为了突出区分经济增长的永久性变化与暂时性变化的定量重要性，我们利用实证估计结果和理论框架，预测了气候变化导致未来气温升高的影响。我们发现，所产生的损失相当可观，但小于假定气温变化会永久性影响经济增长的现有实证文献中的估计。

title: Seawalls and Stilts: A Quantitative Macro Study of Climate Adaptation
abstract: Can we reduce the damage from climate change by investing in seawalls, stilts, or other forms of adaptation? Focusing on the case of severe storms in the US, I develop a macro heterogeneous-agent model to quantify the interactions between adaptation, federal disaster policy, and climate change. The model departs from the standard climate damage function and incorporates the damage from storms as the realization of idiosyncratic shocks. Using the calibrated model, I infer that adaptation capital comprises approximately 1$\%$ of the US capital stock. I find that while the moral hazard effects from disaster aid reduce adaptation in the US economy, federal subsidies for investment in adaptation more than correct for the moral hazard. I introduce climate change into the model as a permanent increase in either or both the severity or probability of storms. Adaptation reduces the damage from this climate change by approximately one-third. Finally, I show that modelling the idiosyncratic risk component of climate damage has quantitatively important implications for adaptation and for the welfare cost of climate change.
abstract_zh: 我们能否通过投资海堤、高脚屋或其他形式的适应措施来减少气候变化造成的损害？本文以美国的强风暴为案例，构建了一个宏观异质性主体模型，以量化适应措施、联邦灾害政策与气候变化之间的相互作用。该模型突破了标准的气候损害函数，将风暴损害视为个体特异性冲击的实现。利用校准后的模型，我推断适应性资本约占美国资本存量的约1%。我发现，尽管灾害援助带来的道德风险效应会减少美国经济中的适应性投资，但联邦政府对适应性投资的补贴足以纠正这种道德风险，并且有余。我将气候变化引入模型，将其表示为风暴的严重程度或发生概率（或两者同时）的永久性上升。适应措施可以将这种气候变化造成的损害减少约三分之一。最后，我表明，对气候损害中的个体异质性风险部分进行建模，在定量上对适应措施和气候变化的福利成本具有重要含义。

title: Rural Electrification, Migration and Structural Transformation: Evidence from Ethiopia
Climate Policy and Innovation: A Quantitative Macroeconomic Analysis
abstract: A carbon tax can induce innovation in green technologies. I evaluate the quantitative impact of this channel in a dynamic, general equilibrium model with endogenous innovation in fossil, green, and nonenergy inputs. I discipline the parameters using evidence from historical oil shocks, after which both energy prices and energy innovation increased substantially. I find that a carbon tax induces large changes in innovation. This innovation response increases the effectiveness of the policy at reducing emissions, resulting in a 19.2 percent decrease in the size of the carbon tax required to reduce emissions by 30 percent in 20 years. (JEL H23, O31, Q41, Q48, Q54, Q55, Q58)
abstract_zh: 碳税可以诱发绿色技术的创新。我在一个动态一般均衡模型中评估了这一渠道的定量影响，该模型中化石能源、绿色能源和非能源投入的创新均为内生。我利用历史上石油冲击的证据校准参数，在这些冲击之后，能源价格和能源创新都大幅上升。我发现，碳税会引起创新的大幅变化。这种创新反应提高了该政策减少排放的有效性，使得在20年内将排放减少30%所需的碳税规模下降了19.2%。（JEL分类号：H23、O31、Q41、Q48、Q54、Q55、Q58）

title: Stuck in a Corner? Climate Policy in Developing Countries
abstract: Much of the capital equipment used in developing countries is created in the OECD and, thus, is designed to make optimal use of the relative supplies of capital, labor, and energy in these developed countries. However, differences in capital–labor ratios between developed and developing countries create a mismatch between the energy requirements of this capital and developing countries' optimal levels of energy intensity. Using a calibrated macroeconomic model, this paper analyzes the implications of this mismatch for climate policy. I find that using capital equipment with “inappropriate” energy intensity has sizeable consequences for both the effectiveness and the welfare cost of climate policies in developing countries.
abstract_zh: 发展中国家使用的大部分资本设备是在经合组织国家设计和制造的，因此其设计旨在最优地利用这些发达国家中资本、劳动力和能源的相对供给。然而，发达国家与发展中国家之间资本—劳动比率的差异，使得这些资本设备的能源需求与发展中国家最优能源强度水平之间产生错配。利用一个经过校准的宏观经济模型，本文分析了这种错配对气候政策的影响。我发现，使用能源强度“不适当”的资本设备，会对发展中国家气候政策的有效性和福利成本产生相当大的影响。

title: The Distributional Effects of Adopting a Carbon Tax on Current and Future Generations
abstract: This paper examines the non-environmental welfare effects of introducing a revenue- neutral carbon tax policy. Using a life cycle model, we find that the welfare effects of the policy differ substantially for agents who are alive when the policy is enacted compared to those who are born into the new steady state with the carbon tax in place. Consistent with previous studies, we demonstrate that, for those born in the new steady state, the welfare costs are always lower when the carbon tax revenue is used to reduce an existing distortionary tax as opposed to being returned in the form of lump-sum payments. In contrast, during the transition, we find that rebating the revenue with a lump sum transfer is less costly than using the revenue to reduce the distortionary labor tax. Additionally, we find that the tax policy is substantially more regressive over the transition than in the steady state, regardless of what is done with the revenue. Overall, our results demonstrate that estimates of the non-environmental welfare costs of carbon tax policies that are based solely on the long-run, steady state outcomes may ultimately paint too rosy of a picture. Thus, when designing climate policies, policymakers must pay careful attention to not only the long-run outcomes, but also the transitional welfare costs and regressivity of the policy.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了引入收入中性碳税政策的非环境福利效应。利用生命周期模型，我们发现，对于政策实施时仍在世的人群，与出生于已实施碳税的新稳态中的人群相比，该政策的福利效应存在显著差异。与以往研究一致，我们证明，对于出生于新稳态的人群而言，将碳税收入用于减少现有扭曲性税收，其福利成本始终低于以一次性总额方式返还的情形。相反，在过渡期间，我们发现以一次性总额转移支付返还收入的成本，低于将收入用于减少扭曲性劳动税的成本。此外，我们发现，无论收入如何使用，该税收政策在过渡期间的累退性都显著高于稳态。总体而言，我们的结果表明，仅基于长期稳态结果来估计碳税政策的非环境福利成本，最终可能描绘出过于乐观的图景。因此，在设计气候政策时，政策制定者不仅必须关注长期结果，还必须仔细考虑转型期的福利成本以及政策的累退性。
